purpose: vyr conformance fixtures — the vyvanse widget-capability set as the verbatim vy_ IR wire request (no lowering). Generated by vyvanse (vyvanse/preview/vyr_conformance.py), committed INTO vyr per the vyr plan invariant I8 so vyr CI runs standalone. See #321.

probe_schema.coords: cell-absolute pixels in the fixture's own w×h (120×120) space — the same space vyr rasterises into; read img.get_pixel(x,y) directly
probe_schema.colours: #RRGGBB; tol is a max per-channel delta
probe_schema.geometry: {role, kind: box|border|fill, bbox:[x,y,w,h], tol_px} — border drawn INSIDE the bounds (outer extent == bounds); fill = interior after the inside-border inset (x+bw,y+bw,w-2bw,h-2bw)
probe_schema.colour: {role, element: fill|border, point:[x,y], expected:#RRGGBB, tol} — point sample vs the IR-declared colour
probe_schema.fade: {role, alpha, point:[x,y], fg, bg, expected, blend: source_over, tol} — expected = analytic fg·α + bg·(1−α) over the white card
probe_schema.derivation: EXPECTED is computed from the SPEC (docs/widget-pixel-geometry.md Part A box model) + the fixture's own IR attrs — NOT from any render, so it is the canonical truth a render is graded against
